title: leobordea pusilla
intro: Leobordea pusilla, commonly known as 'Tulsi' or 'Holy Basil', is an aromatic and sacred plant in Ayurvedic medicine that has been used for centuries. It has been found to offer several health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving respiratory health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Leobordea pusilla include antioxidant, adaptogenic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to protect the body from oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include eugenol, ursolic acid, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
